svg.title: OneX Hub 15-step runtime flow
svg.desc: A three-stage, fifteen-step flow shows how the OneX Hub Cloud Run service authenticates a user, validates the selected application with Spool, returns the Hub frontend, directs the browser to CDN-hosted MFE and Thread assets, and orchestrates a search request through Apigee to the backend.
svg.text: Cloud Run hosts the Hub service · CDN delivers approved UI assets · the browser renders the selected application
The Hub Cloud Run service receives the URL, establishes trust and returns the Hub frontend
The browser asks for approved configuration, then downloads and renders the selected MFE and Thread
The UI sends a trusted operation through the Hub service and displays the backend response
MFE sends an approved operation key
Apigee routes it to the backend
Cloud Run hosts and protects the Hub; Spool describes the approved app; CDN delivers the UI; the browser renders it; Apigee and the backend handle business requests.
Browser executes Hub, MFE and Thread
Backend remains the source of truth
